title: Quick and Springy Filipino King Prawns Bistek
description: A light and flavorful Filipino-inspired dish made with raw king prawns, bell peppers, and onions, slow-cooked in a tagine pot for a tender and juicy texture. Perfect for a quick and healthy dinner option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the raw king prawns and cook for 1-2 minutes, until they start to turn pink.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, black pepper, and salt, and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven, and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the prawns are cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh lime wedges and chopped cilantro if desired.
Note: Cooking time may vary depending on the size of the prawns and the oven temperature.
Be sure to check the prawns for doneness by cutting into one, if it is opaque and firm to the touch, it is cooked through.
